newNarrative.evidence: Each constituent: exact chain + address, covered launchpad, and token metadata or an official source describing the shared mechanism or story. The story: at least one independent public source (official page or X post) beyond token metadata.
newNarrative.daily: Every run evaluates every theme cluster discover.py reports and records a decision in curation.clusterDecisions (created, assigned, rejected or deferred, with a reason). Create a narrative whenever a cluster or a story meets this bar; at the cap, replace the weakest narrative only when the new one has more 24h volume and its story is current.

addMember.evidence: Same evidence bar as a new narrative constituent.

removeMember.evidence: Below the threshold on two consecutive observations, or evidence that contradicts membership (for example removal from an official registry). Close the membership interval; never delete the record.

retireNarrative.evidence: Below the threshold on two consecutive observations, or the defining source is gone. Record the reason; keep memberships as closed intervals.

quarantine.evidence: Flagged tokens are never constituents; record them as quarantined candidates.

storyChecks.note: discover.py stories writes the cluster theme searches (up to 10); remaining budget is for targeted follow-ups. Each X search is about 7 credits; each page scrape about 5.
